[name="黍"]这是你的因果。
[name="黍"]如果你没有行差踏错，确实在走向那个终点，这把种子会在合适的时候发芽，结出你想要的果。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]你也会给我出题了。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_2025_shu_1#5$1")]
[name="黍"]总不能一直让你刁难我们。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]呵……
[name="望"]我的事情已经谈完了，还有什么事，你自己说吧。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#3$1")]
[name="绩"]……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_2025_shu_1#17$1")]
[name="黍"]真是长大了，翅膀硬了？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#7$1")]
[name="绩"]我都一千岁了……姐姐。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_2025_shu_1#5$1")]
[name="黍"]我拦不住你。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#9$1")]
[name="绩"]上次走的时候还大吵了一架，这一次能不能给我留样东西，当个念想？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_2025_shu_1#17$1")]
[name="黍"]整座大荒城都被你织到了那幅锦绣里，你还想要带走什么？
[name="黍"]你要是还有什么不舍的，最好活着回来。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#7$1")]
[name="绩"]说的也是……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#9$1")]
[name="绩"]夕，能不能最后再问你要一样东西？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avgnew_2015_dusk_1#1$1")]
[name="夕"]你想要什么？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#9$1")]
[name="绩"]那幅画，可以提前给我吗？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avgnew_2015_dusk_1#9$1")]
[name="夕"]你怎么知——
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avgnew_2015_dusk_1#2$1")]
[name="夕"]……
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_throwstone", volume=1)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.2, xstrength=5, ystrength=10, vibrato=10, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#9$1")]
[delay(time=1)]
[name="绩"]我会好好保管的。
